name: FSampler skip by epsilon extrapolation
plain: Library copy keeps just the step file. Each solver step can skip a model call using linear or Richardson extrapolation of epsilon history, plus a learned scale.
math: should_skip_model_call(...). ε̂=extrapolate_linear/richardson(hist). x0̂=x+ε̂. Real epsilon alone goes to history. dpmpp_2m step uses ε̂/L.

providers.note: Partial copy: engine module imported on line 2 absent

label: from code
surprise: Library copy has sampling_engine.py only, its engine import is missing.

audit.note: ε̂/L is not specific to dpmpp_2m: the Euler skip also divides by L when history has ≥3 entries before x0̂=x+ε̂ (ComfyUI-FSampler/sampling/sampling_engine.py:52-54); first skips with shorter history are unscaled. ε here is x0−x, not noise (line 81). L is an EMA of ‖ε̂‖/‖ε‖ clamped to [0.5,2] (lines 91-97).
